results.title: Patch-to-Exploit Without Humans: GTIG’s exploit_agent and the Grace Period – Lab Space
results.description: GTIG’s Q4 2026 AI Threat Tracker, titled “Agentic Threat Activity Crosses a Significant Threshold,” describes exploit_agent as a multi-agent vulnerability research and weaponization framework that integrates with multiple frontier and locally hosted LLMs [1]. Its workflow, as GTIG describes it, runs continuous differential analysis against popular web application software: it compares code before and after patch announcements, analyzes the differences to identify likely vulnerabilities, drafts exploits, and executes them without human intervention [1]. GTIG did not publish the framework’s internal agent roles or model assignments.
